visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two cats, a brown tabby and a tricolor calico, are positioned on a light blue patterned fabric atop a wooden surface. A tall wooden cat tree stands in the background against a large window showing bright city buildings. The tabby is actively licking the calico's upper back. (2) The camera angle shifts to a closer shot as the tabby licks the calico's neck and head. The calico cat keeps its eyes partially closed and ears slightly back, exhibiting a relaxed and submissive facial expression. Bright natural daylight illuminates the scene from the window. (3) The tabby cat abruptly stops grooming its companion, pauses for a second, and then turns its head to vigorously lick its own front paw and chest. The calico remains stationary, staring blankly ahead with wide eyes as yellow text variety captions appear at the bottom.
